events.title: The Lantern-Quilt Infirmary
events.description: A round, button-eyed nurse hangs warm quilts beside a midnight-teal lantern.

choices.text: Pay 12 gold to dress one hero's wounds (+8 HP)
Donate 4 HP for a purse of 18 gold
Leave the lantern burning

events.title: The Button-Heart Shrine
events.description: A moss-cloaked doll tends a beating brass button stitched into a chapel wall.

choices.text: Spend 2 scraps to sew a lasting heart seam (+3 max HP)
Give up 2 max HP for 24 gold
Let the little heart keep ticking

events.title: The Needle-Thorn Garden
events.description: Oxblood roses made of fabric bristle with huge blunt sewing needles.

choices.text: Endure 6 HP loss to salvage 3 scraps
Spend 10 gold on rose balm (+6 HP)
Slip through the unpricked path

events.title: The Thimble-Moon Sanctuary
events.description: A bone-cream thimble glows above a congregation of velvet ragdolls.

choices.text: Pay 16 gold to strengthen a hero's seams (+2 max HP)
Lose 4 HP tending the candles; earn 20 gold
Leave the sanctuary undisturbed

events.title: The Forgotten Straw Bed
events.description: A short scarecrow sleeps under a mustard quilt, its straw spilling onto a velvet pillow.

choices.text: Spend 2 scraps on fresh stuffing (+10 HP)
Give up 5 HP worth of straw for 22 gold
Tuck the quilt in and depart

events.title: The Oxblood Stitch Oracle
events.description: A large-eyed doll reads the future in thread stretched across a crimson hoop.

choices.text: Lose 1 max HP to receive 2 scraps
Spend 30 gold to gain 4 lasting max HP
Refuse the prophecy and go

events.title: The Lacebound Mirror
events.description: A plum-velvet mirror shows a button-eyed doll with one seam stronger and one button missing.

choices.text: Spend 2 scraps; mend 4 HP and add 2 lasting max HP
Break the reflection for 25 gold; lose 2 max HP
Cover the mirror and leave

events.title: The Ashthread Balcony
events.description: Beneath a midnight-teal bell, dolls sing through seams filled with glowing ash.

choices.text: Lose 5 HP to gain 2 lasting max HP
Cut the bell cord for 19 gold; lose 3 HP
Leave the choir singing

events.title: The Copper-Moon Puppet
events.description: A giant round-headed marionette holds a warm copper moon between stitched hands.

choices.text: Pay 18 gold; heal 6 HP and gain 1 max HP
Salvage 3 scraps but lose 7 HP
Let the puppet bow

events.title: The Bone-Cream Wardrobe
events.description: A moonlit wardrobe offers one soft lining and one permanent bone-cream hem.

choices.text: Spend 1 scrap; heal 8 HP but lose 1 max HP
Pay 25 gold for 3 lasting max HP
Close the wardrobe doors

events.title: The Mosslit Seam Trial
events.description: A moss-clad ragdoll judge weighs thread against a glowing, stitched heart.

choices.text: Lose 6 HP; receive 2 scraps and 1 max HP
Pay 16 gold for 2 lasting max HP
Decline the trial

events.title: The Duskwoven Cocoon
events.description: An enormous quilted moth cocoon glows rose-gold beside the road.

choices.text: Spend 2 scraps; heal 7 HP and gain 1 max HP
Take 24 gold in silk; lose 1 max HP
Leave the cocoon untouched

events.title: The Wakeful Darning House
events.description: A round button-eyed tailor keeps a bone-cream darning room lit until dawn, with warm quilts stacked at the door.

choices.text: Pay 14 gold for a warm seam (+9 HP)
Trade 2 max HP for 20 gold
Leave the darning room asleep

events.title: The Silver Bobbin Oath
events.description: A little brass-eyed vowkeeper winds silver thread around a carved spool beneath an amber lamp.

choices.text: Spend 2 scraps to gain 2 max HP and mend 3 HP
Sell one scrap of silver thread for 17 gold
Keep your promises for another night

events.title: The Crowshade Hearth
events.description: Beneath a moss-green quilt awning, a plush crow tends a kettle on a tiny lantern stove.

choices.text: Give 5 HP of stuffing for 2 scraps
Pay 11 gold for a bowl of stitched broth (+7 HP)
Leave the kettle simmering

events.title: The Briar Button Sentinel
events.description: A stout velvet guardian guards a gate of blunt thorn-pins, one golden button shining in its chest.

choices.text: Lose 4 HP to gain 1 max HP and 1 scrap
Buy a lasting safety seam for 19 gold (+2 max HP)
Pass the guardian without touching its pins

events.title: The Mossveil Patch Auditor
events.description: A broad patch-covered doll stamps every seam in a midnight-teal ledger with a giant thimble.

choices.text: Give up 2 max HP for 28 gold
Spend 2 scraps to restore 8 HP
Close the ledger and go

events.title: The Velvet Moon Ward
events.description: A rounded lantern-bearing ragdoll nurses a crescent quilt under a plum-coloured button moon.

choices.text: Spend 1 scrap and lose 3 HP for 2 max HP
Pay 18 gold to recover 9 HP
Leave the moon ward in peace

events.title: The Midnight Thimble Bath
events.description: A round-eyed bathkeeper hangs damp plum quilts above a copper tub warmed by a little lantern.

choices.text: Trade one lasting seam for a warm bath (heal 10 HP; lose 1 max HP)
Pay 15 gold for warm thread towels (+6 HP)
Leave the copper tub steaming

events.title: The Bellglass Menders
events.description: Three button-eyed dolls stitch cracks in an enormous oxblood glass bell.

choices.text: Lose 6 HP to earn 9 gold and 3 scraps
Spend 3 scraps to gain 3 lasting max HP
Leave the bell unstruck

events.title: The Crowfeather Bobbin Mill
events.description: A stuffed crow turns a towering bobbin mill beneath moss-coloured quilt sails.

choices.text: Surrender 2 max HP for 22 gold
Pay 17 gold and 1 scrap to gain 2 max HP
Let the turning mill pass

events.title: The Oxblood Moth Quilt
events.description: A lantern-lit moth ragdoll unfurls a warm quilt patched with glowing rose cloth.

choices.text: Spend 2 scraps; heal 7 HP and gain 1 max HP
Lose 7 HP and receive 25 gold
Fold the quilt without a bargain

events.title: The Silver Pin Census
events.description: A watchful plush clerk counts silver pins in a midnight-teal stitched ledger.

choices.text: Lose 4 HP to gain 1 scrap and 13 gold
Spend 18 gold to gain 2 lasting max HP
Close the silver ledger

events.title: The Mossbutton Medicine Chest
events.description: A squat stitched apothecary opens a button-latched chest of soft bandages.

choices.text: Pay 12 gold and 1 scrap to heal 11 HP
Lose 3 max HP for 33 gold
Latch the medicine chest shut

events.title: The Crowfeather Sickbay
events.description: A plush midnight crow tends tiny quilts beneath a warm brass lantern while patched travellers shelter from rain.

choices.text: Pay 13 gold for crow-feather bandages (+8 HP)
Give 3 HP worth of stuffing for 2 scraps
Leave the quilts folded

events.title: The Copper-Spine Shrine
events.description: A round ragdoll sentinel holds a copper-thread backbone across an oxblood altar of soft sewn cushions.

choices.text: Spend 3 scraps for a lasting copper brace (+3 max HP)
Trade 2 max HP for 20 gold
Leave the copper brace untouched

events.title: The Bell-Moth Hospice
events.description: A broad button-eyed moth nurse rings a bone-cream bell above a bedside lit by amber lantern oil.

choices.text: Pay 15 gold for glow treatment (+7 HP, +1 max HP)
Give 4 HP for 19 gold worth of lantern wicks
Let the hospice bell fall silent

events.title: The Straw-Bell Keeper
events.description: A squat pumpkin-faced keeper gathers fallen straw beneath a moss-coloured bell stitched into the road's canopy.

choices.text: Spend 2 scraps to restuff a wound (+5 HP)
Trade 1 max HP of stuffing for 12 gold
Pass beneath the hanging straw bell

events.title: The Teal-Dye Washhouse
events.description: Round apron-wearing dolls wring indigo quilts above a midnight-teal basin warmed by little copper lamps.

choices.text: Pay 11 gold for a healing cloth wrap (+7 HP)
Give 3 HP of effort to salvage 1 scrap
Leave the indigo quilts to dry

events.title: The Oxblood Button Rite
events.description: A patched button priestess sews a shining brass heart into a velvet cushion as the candle wax drips.

choices.text: Spend 1 scrap and 4 HP to gain 2 max HP
Surrender 2 max HP to take 23 gold
Keep your own button-heart

events.title: The Cindersilk Ledger
events.description: A stout ink-eyed tax doll records lost stitches by candlelight.

choices.text: Burn 5 HP of worn stuffing for 14 gold and 1 scrap
Pay 22 gold to reinforce your seams (+3 max HP)
Close the ledger and pass

events.title: The Starlit Needle Mill
events.description: Round night workers wind silver needles into a towering velvet bobbin.

choices.text: Spend 2 scraps to heal 8 HP and gain 1 max HP
Lose 2 max HP for 25 gold
Leave the needle mill turning

events.title: The Rosewindow Sickroom
events.description: A button-eyed nurse warms stitched rose petals beside a painted glass window.

choices.text: Pay 15 gold for a rose-petal poultice (+10 HP)
Give 4 HP of warm stuffing for 2 scraps
Leave the petals undisturbed

events.title: The Bronze Pin Oath
events.description: A short velvet oathkeeper offers a glowing pin over a folded midnight quilt.

choices.text: Spend 6 gold, 1 scrap and 2 HP for 2 lasting max HP
Surrender 1 max HP for 23 gold
Refuse the bronze pin

events.title: The Velvet Stitchwell
events.description: Beneath a moss-green canopy, a moonlit well is lined with neat cloth stitches.

choices.text: Offer 1 scrap; heal 6 HP and gain 2 max HP
Lose 5 HP hauling the quilt rope; earn 18 gold
Leave the moonlit well untouched

events.title: The Owlsilk Apothecary
events.description: A round owl-faced ragdoll doles out amber lantern oil from damask pockets.

choices.text: Pay 12 gold to mend 8 HP with warm lantern oil
Unpick 1 max HP to salvage 1 scrap
Fold the damask pockets and go

events.title: The Ribbon Court
events.description: A round velvet magistrate pins scarlet ribbons to a stitched verdict board beneath a warm brass lantern.

choices.text: Spend 22 gold and 1 scrap on a lasting scarlet seam (+4 max HP)
Give 5 HP of stuffing to receive the court's 27-gold purse
Leave the verdict hanging

events.title: The Mothglass Lantern Vault
events.description: A squat, button-eyed keeper tends a great cracked lantern where round cloth moths nest among jewel-toned glass.

choices.text: Pay 18 gold for healing glow (+9 HP, +1 max HP)
Carry a hot lantern wick (lose 6 HP; gain 3 scraps)
Let the moths sleep

events.title: The Strawbound Loom
events.description: A pumpkin-faced plush loomkeeper knots fraying straw hearts on a giant moss-green weaving frame.

choices.text: Sell an old heart seam (lose 2 max HP; gain 26 gold)
Spend 3 scraps to restuff a heart (+5 HP, +2 max HP)
Leave the loom's hearts beating

events.title: The Sable Clock Doll
events.description: A broad midnight-plum clock doll holds a ticking button moon, its big brass hands stitched to its sleeves.

choices.text: Wind the clock with 8 HP of effort for 3 lasting max HP
Pawn the clock hands (lose 3 HP; earn 18 gold and 1 scrap)
Let the clock count another night

events.title: The Copper-Moth Choir
events.description: A chorus of round moth-faced ragdolls sings beneath a copper bell sewn into an oxblood velvet arch.

choices.text: Pay 24 gold and 1 scrap for a bright seam (+4 HP, +2 max HP)
Burn a lasting seam for the choir (lose 1 max HP; earn 29 gold)
Keep the bell quiet

events.title: The Nightquilt Watchtower
events.description: A stout button-eyed watch doll guards a tower of midnight-teal quilts with a broad quilted lantern-shield.

choices.text: Take the night watch (lose 7 HP; earn 23 gold and 1 scrap)
Pay 12 gold and 2 scraps for a lasting watch hem (+3 max HP)
Pass beneath the shield in peace

events.title: The Candle-Bell Tollhouse
events.description: A stout velvet tollkeeper grips a brass bell beside a midnight-teal bridge wrapped in glowing lantern thread.

choices.text: Pay 13 gold and 1 scrap for a guarded seam (+2 max HP)
Stand the cold bell watch (lose 5 HP; gain 17 gold)
Pass the bell without a bargain

events.title: The Inkfern Apothecary
events.description: A round button-eyed herbalist tends dark stitched ferns inside a bone-cream tent lit by rose lanterns.

choices.text: Pay 16 gold for an inkfern wrap (+10 HP)
Trade 2 max HP of lasting seam for 3 scraps
Leave the ferns to the moon

events.title: The Silver-Stitch Observatory
events.description: A plump star-chart doll winds silver thread around an enormous telescope under a plum quilt sky.

choices.text: Spend 3 scraps to mend 3 HP and gain 2 max HP
Watch the cold star (lose 6 HP; gain 26 gold)
Fold the chart and depart

events.title: The Sable Button Foundry
events.description: A squat soot-coloured buttonsmith works a velvet furnace, its giant brass buttons glowing like small suns.

choices.text: Pay 18 gold and 1 scrap for a strong button heart (+3 max HP)
Pawn the old heart seam (lose 2 max HP; gain 25 gold)
Let the foundry fire die down

events.title: The Briarlace Ferry
events.description: A round velvet ferryman poles a lantern-lit boat through mossy water stitched with thorny lace.

choices.text: Ford the cold water (lose 4 HP; gain 8 gold and 2 scraps)
Pay 15 gold for a sheltered crossing (+7 HP)
Stay on the safe bank

events.title: The Lantern-Wisp Clocktower
events.description: A button-eyed moth clockkeeper winds luminous brass hands above a tower quilted in deep oxblood and teal.

choices.text: Spend 2 scraps to restore 8 HP and gain 1 max HP
Sell one lasting hour (lose 1 max HP; gain 21 gold)
Let the clock strike without you

events.title: The Compass-Hollow Doll
events.description: A squat button-eyed wayfinder carries a compass larger than its round chest; the brass needle twitches toward frayed seams in the road.

choices.text: Follow the wobbling needle (lose 4 HP; gain 17 gold and 1 scrap)
Spend 2 scraps to stitch a steady north (+2 max HP)
Leave the compass spinning

events.title: The Thimble-Snail Post
events.description: A plump snail postmaster drags a giant brass thimble shell lined with plum ribbon and lantern-lit letters.

choices.text: Pay 14 gold to patch the shell and rest (+8 HP)
Carry moon mail (lose 3 HP; earn 2 scraps)
Let the thimble snail pass

events.title: The Glass-Pin Snowglobe
events.description: A stitched winter doll shakes a globe of tiny quilted hills, and blunt silver pins glitter like slow snow.

choices.text: Pay 9 gold and 1 scrap to warm the globe (+5 HP, +1 max HP)
Shake out frozen buttons (lose 5 HP; gain 24 gold)
Leave the little storm asleep

events.title: The Soot-Needle Chimney
events.description: A round charcoal chimney sweep lifts an oversized bristle needle beneath a crooked oxblood roof with stitched smoke stars.

choices.text: Pay 16 gold to sew fireproof padding (+2 max HP)
Rake the cinders (lose 1 max HP; gain 3 scraps)
Let the smoke stars settle

events.title: The Amber Needle Music Box
events.description: A plump velvet music-box doll turns a giant brass sewing needle as notes glow in its oxblood seams.

choices.text: Pay 15 gold and 1 scrap to wind the warm lullaby (+6 HP, +1 max HP)
Pull a sharp silver note (lose 6 HP; gain 24 gold)
Let the music box fall silent

events.title: The Moss-Button Puppet Ward
events.description: A round moss-cloaked puppet nurse pins oversized felt knee patches onto sleeping button-eyed dolls.

choices.text: Spend 2 scraps to patch a battered knee (+8 HP)
Trade a lasting seam for 26 gold (lose 2 max HP)
Leave the sleeping dolls undisturbed

events.title: The Starlace Mirror Carriage
events.description: A rotund mirror-faced coachman polishes star-shaped safety pins on a quilt-lined midnight carriage.

choices.text: Pay 21 gold for a star-shaped anchor (+3 max HP)
Pull a shard through your sleeve (lose 4 HP; gain 2 scraps)
Let the carriage roll away

events.title: The Cinder-Loom Guardian
events.description: A stout soot-dusted ragdoll tends a glowing needle loom, its button eyes lit like coals.

choices.text: Pay 12 gold and 1 scrap for a warm seam (+5 HP, +1 max HP)
Pawn a reinforced hem (lose 1 max HP; gain 20 gold)
Leave the loom glowing softly

events.title: The Moth-Wing Parasol Shelter
events.description: A plump button-eyed parasol-keeper unfolds a giant plum umbrella edged in stitched moth wings beside the rain-dark road.

choices.text: Pay 13 gold for a dry quilt lining (+7 HP)
Catch the sharp thread-rain (lose 4 HP; gain 2 scraps)
Walk beyond the shadow of the parasol

events.title: The Iron-Key Dollhouse
events.description: A round velvet locksmith raises a door-sized brass key before a tiny oxblood house with warm button windows.

choices.text: Spend 9 gold and 2 scraps to line a keyhole (+2 max HP)
Unpick one lasting key seam for 23 gold (lose 1 max HP)
Let the little house keep its secrets

events.title: The Gloam Patch-Kite
events.description: A round-headed puppet child flies an enormous patched star kite above a midnight-teal hill, its long tail held by brass pins.

choices.text: Spend 1 scrap to steady the kite tail (+5 HP, +1 max HP)
Chase the loose kite in cold wind (lose 5 HP; gain 16 gold)
Wave to the kite as it climbs

events.title: The Rustbell Locket Tree
events.description: A squat moss-coated gardener lifts a brass locket from a tree of rust-red button fruit, each branch tied with cream thread.

choices.text: Pay 20 gold to sew a locket into a lasting heart seam (+3 max HP)
Climb for a rustbell locket (lose 3 HP; gain 11 gold and 1 scrap)
Leave the lockets chiming in the wind

events.title: The Ember-Mitten Hatch
events.description: A plump badger-shaped oven keeper lifts a house-sized oxblood quilt mitt from a tiny furnace hatch, its brass-button eyes shining in the amber firelight.

choices.text: Pay 14 gold for the mitten's warm stuffing (+8 HP)
Carry glowing coals through the cold (lose 5 HP; gain 18 gold)
Let the furnace hatch click shut

events.title: The Briar-Staple Bridge
events.description: A round moss-cloaked bridge keeper braces a swaying patchwork footbridge with a giant copper safety pin while stitched briars tug at the rope seams.

choices.text: Spend 2 scraps on a lasting safety-pin seam (+2 max HP)
Unpick an old staple for the keeper (lose 2 max HP; gain 24 gold)
Cross without disturbing the pin

events.title: The Moon-Threadfish Lantern
events.description: A rotund midnight-teal fish doll floats beneath a quilted canal bridge, dragging an enormous amber lantern from its ribbon tail.

choices.text: Pay 11 gold and 1 scrap to mend the lantern gill (+5 HP, +1 max HP)
Snag the loose lantern thread (lose 4 HP; gain 2 scraps)
Watch the threadfish drift into the dark

events.title: The Honeycomb Button Hive
events.description: A squat moss-and-mustard hive with great brass button holes hums as fat striped cloth bees stitch amber honey into a velvet teacup.

choices.text: Pay 19 gold for a cup of warming button honey (+9 HP)
Give the hive one lasting heart seam (lose 1 max HP; gain 27 gold)
Leave the buzzing button hive asleep

events.title: The Plum Accordion Sickroom
events.description: A round plum-cloth nurse pumps a concertina as large as a bed, its bone-cream bellows sewn with red healing stitches.

choices.text: Pay 15 gold to warm the stitched bellows (heal 7 HP)
Pump the heavy concertina for wages (lose 4 HP; gain 18 gold)
Leave the accordion sleeping

events.title: The Copper Hedgehog Pin Bower
events.description: A squat moss hedgehog doll carries a bristling silver pincushion on its back; giant copper safety pins hold a canopy of quilt leaves.

choices.text: Spend 2 scraps to fasten a lasting heart pin (+2 max HP)
Unpick a lasting heart pin for 23 gold (lose 2 max HP)
Leave the copper pins beneath their leaves

events.title: The Teal Swan Needleboat
events.description: A plump midnight-teal swan puppet glides in a coat-shaped boat, its oversized silver needle beak stitching the torn canal moon.

choices.text: Pay 12 gold and 1 scrap to mend the moon-sail (+5 HP, +1 max HP)
Dive for lost thread (lose 3 HP; gain 2 scraps)
Let the swan's needleboat drift on

events.title: The Rose-Button Teapot Oracle
events.description: A round rose-cloth fortune keeper pours glowing tea from a giant button-lidded teapot; steam forms stitched heart-shaped clouds.

choices.text: Pay 17 gold for hot heart tea (heal 8 HP)
Unpick 1 max HP for the teapot keeper (gain 21 gold)
Leave the rose-button lid closed
